svg.aria-label: Technical stack. Languages: C# and Python (core focus), JavaScript, HTML, CSS, C. Frameworks, tools and environments: .NET (core focus), Git, GitHub, Azure, VS Code, Linux. Currently exploring: Rust, Go. Beyond how to use a technology, I'm interested in the trade-offs behind it: performance, complexity, maintainability, and suitability for a given problem.
